title: Dual-Cheese Gougères
subtitle: Technical Recipe Formulation Sheet

meta.source: Document Type: Standard Operating Procedure & Formulation Sheet — Savory Pastry / Choux Dough (Pâte à Choux). Target application: low-residue, ambient-stable finger food for event catering.

specs.label: Critical Texture
specs.value: Crisp rigid crust; hollow, moist, airy crumb; non-greasy exterior

scalingPrinciple: Item A.01 (Filtered Water) is locked at 100.0% as the hydration baseline for the choux. All other base components read as a percentage of that water mass, the conventional way choux ratios are expressed. The finished base paste is then divided by mass — not by eye — into two equal sub-batches before inclusions are folded in.

rows.name: Whole Milk (3.25% Fat)
rows.role: Maillard browning enhancement via lactose; tenderizes crumb.

rows.name: Unsalted Butter (80% Milkfat)
rows.role: Shortens gluten strands for crispness; emulsification fat base.

rows.name: All-Purpose Flour (~11% Protein)
rows.role: Starch gelatinization baseline; structural integrity builder.

rows.name: Whole Liquid Eggs (Room Temp)
rows.role: Leavening steam, protein coagulation structure, lecithin emulsifier.

total.role: Master base paste before diversion (~324 g per sub-batch).

formulations.title: Phase Diversion & Flavor Inclusion Metrics
formulations.intro: Prior to the piping phase, the master base paste must be divided precisely into two equal mass quantities (approx. 324 grams of base paste per sub-batch) to execute the separate flavor streams.

rows.name: Aged Gouda
rows.role: Stream Alpha. Deep, nutty, caramelized profile with subtle wood-smoke undertones.

rows.name: Extra-Sharp White Cheddar
rows.role: Stream Beta. Sharp, tangy, high-acid savory profile balanced by clean spice heat.

matrixFootnote: *Egg mass is the source's own approximation for 4 large eggs; cheese masses are the source's stated approximations for 1/2 cup grated. Percentages for the inclusion streams are expressed against the ~324 g divided sub-batch, not the full base.

execution.name: Thermal Pre-conditioning & Mise en Place
execution.text: Adjust target oven parameters to 400°F (204°C). Line rigid aluminum baking sheets with non-stick silicone-treated parchment. Ensure eggs are verified at room temperature (~70°F / 21°C).

execution.name: Liquid Liquidization & Lipid Fusion
execution.text: In a heavy-bottomed stainless steel saucepan, combine the water, whole milk, cubed unsalted butter, and salt. Bring to a rapid rolling boil. Adjust timing so that the butter completely liquefies at the exact moment boiling commences, to limit vaporized water loss.

execution.name: Starch Gelatinization (The Panade Phase)
execution.text: Reduce heat delivery to low. Introduce the total volume of sifted flour instantaneously. Agitate the matrix aggressively using a heavy wooden paddle. Continue cooking and mashing for 2 full minutes. The process is complete when the mixture detaches completely from the pan walls and leaves a translucent starch film across the bottom surface of the cookware.

execution.name: Cooling & Vapor Dissipation
execution.text: Transfer the dense panade paste to a clean mixing bowl. Agitate manually or via a stand mixer paddle on low speed. Monitor paste temperature until it drops below 135°F (57°C) to prevent unintended egg protein coagulation during introduction.

execution.name: Emulsion & Egg Incorporation
execution.text: Introduce the whole eggs sequentially, adding exactly one egg at a time. Mix completely after each addition. The emulsion will temporarily appear fractured and curdled; continue mixing until it regains structural cohesion. The final paste should possess a glossy appearance and drape from a suspended paddle in a clean, stable "V" geometry.

execution.name: Diversion & Inclusion Dispersion
execution.text: Weigh and split the paste into equal halves (~324 g each). Gently fold the microplaned Aged Gouda and smoked paprika into Sub-Batch Alpha. Fold the microplaned Extra-Sharp Cheddar and black pepper into Sub-Batch Beta. Do not over-mix.

execution.name: Extrusion & Thermal Processing
execution.text: Extrude the paste via a piping apparatus with a plain circular tip, or drop via 1 tbsp disher leaving 1.5 inches of clearance between units. Bake undisturbed for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove when golden brown and hollow to the touch.

directive: Maintain a sealed oven door environment for the initial 15 minutes of baking. Opening the door before the protein structure sets collapses the steam envelope, and a collapsed gougère cannot be recovered by extending the bake.
